APUS’s transfer rules

  • Up to 90 semester credits from other sources can count toward the 122-credit degree.
  • At least 32 semester credits must be completed at APUS.
  • APUS caps alternative credit at 60 semester credits.

Source: American Public University: Transfer Credit (transfer credit limits)

Pace used in this example

  • 2–4 completed outside courses per month is a planning assumption, not a provider promise.
  • 3–6 credits per university 8-week session is a planning assumption.
  • Outside providers are studied one after another in this scenario; overlapping study can change the elapsed time.
  • University loads use unit totals. Prerequisites, whole-course scheduling, start dates, breaks and registration availability can add time.
  • One-time university fees are included once; subtract charges you have already paid.

What this range leaves out

  • Uses the $360 standard rate before grants. The 10% Opportunity Grant (applied automatically, $324), Veteran Grant, Everyday Heroes Grant and $250 Preferred Military Rate are not applied.
  • Program-specific technology fees (for example ENGR and ELEN courses) and late-registration fees are not included.
  • 3–6 credits per 8-week session is a planning assumption.
  • Applicable sales tax on course subscriptions.
  • Books, supplies, course-specific charges and transcript charges when applicable.
  • Housing, meals, travel, health insurance and other living costs.
  • Rates are before financial aid, military benefits, scholarships, discounts and future price changes.
  • Completed or reported courses are excluded from new course charges; school acceptance of reported credit remains separate.
  • This is a range of known tuition, required university fees and selected outside-course charges, not a complete cost of attendance or a graduation-date promise.
  • Sophia uses the lowest published mix of monthly, four-month and annual memberships for the assumed study time. Prepaid plans require the upfront payment; promotions and tax are excluded.
  • 6 proposed outside units retain the eligibility conditions shown on their course rows.

Questions

Does Sophia Introduction to Statistics transfer to American Public University System?

Sophia publishes this match: Sophia Introduction to Statistics for MATH302 Statistics (3 semester credits). The match does not come from APUS, so ask APUS to confirm it before you pay for the course.

Does Sophia Art History I transfer to American Public University System?

Sophia publishes this match: Sophia Art History I for Arts & Humanities elective (select 1 course from list) (3 semester credits). The match does not come from APUS, so ask APUS to confirm it before you pay for the course.

How many credits can I transfer into American Public University System’s Bachelor of Science in Computer Science?

APUS’s published limit for this 122-credit degree is 90 semester credits from other sources. At least 32 semester credits must be completed at APUS. This plan proposes 6 semester credits through outside courses.

Which courses must I take at American Public University System?

In this plan, 116 semester credits are taken at APUS, including SCIN233 Physics I with Lab, MATH210 Discrete Mathematics, MATH226 Calculus II, MATH220 Linear Algebra, SCIN234 Physics II with Lab and CSCI140 Introduction to Programming and 24 more. APUS requires at least 32 semester credits at APUS.

Can I choose my own courses in this plan?

Yes. 24 semester credits are open choices, such as Concentration (select one: Artificial Intelligence, Cyber Operations, or Quantum Computing), Communication elective (select 1 course from list) and Natural Sciences elective (select 1 course from list). You pick a course APUS allows, then ask APUS to confirm it counts.

How much does this plan cost?

The planning estimate is $42,209 to $42,209 before aid. It covers tuition, listed fees and the outside courses in this plan. It is not a complete cost of attendance.

Has American Public University System confirmed this plan?

Not yet. Some course matches or open choices in this plan still need APUS’s confirmation. Questions to ask: Some of the school’s published rules for this program are still being confirmed. Ask the school to confirm this plan before paying for outside courses. Ask the school to confirm 1 proposed course match for this exact program before paying for it. Pick a course for 8 open course choices in this plan, then ask the school to confirm they count. Admission and your transcript evaluation are always APUS’s decisions.
